func SettingsPost(c *context.Context, f form.RepoSetting) {
  repo := c.Repo.Repository
  switch c.Query("action") {
  case "update":
    isNameChanged := repo.LowerName != strings.ToLower(f.RepoName)
    if isNameChanged { database.ChangeRepositoryName(c.Repo.Owner, repo.Name, f.RepoName) }

summary: Gogs is a self-hosted Git service (forks/watches/stars repositories, issues, pull requests, milestones, labels, releases, orgs/teams, webhooks, SSH deploy keys, and git-LFS objects), with a relational store (legacy XORM + newer GORM) accessed through database.Handle stores and legacy free functions, exposed over both a web UI and a REST API v1.

_no_edges.why: internal feed-notification writer invoked by issue/PR/repo/star ops; not an HTTP endpoint (internal/database/actions.go:153)
internal filesystem-cleanup helper, no HTTP route, no auth wall, calls nothing exposed (internal/database/notices.go:97)
